## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Madrid, Spain. It starts at Calle de Bailén, Pl. de la Armería, 2. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Fast-track entrance ticket to the Royal Palace of Madrid.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to visit one of Europe's rare palaces, which are official residences of Heads of State and open to the public!
>
> As Europe's largest and most extravagant palace, boasting over 3,000 magnificent rooms, it offers a truly opulent experience. With your ticket to the Madrid Palace, you gain fast-track access to explore this regal residence, where you'll encounter breathtaking vistas, majestic galleries, and intricately adorned chambers that once housed enigmatic European monarchs.
>
> Immerse yourself in the Crown Room, strolling through its grand halls with a dignified air. Marvel at the weaponry on display in the armory and contemplate the masterpieces adorning the painting galleries.
>
> The art collection within the Madrid Palace rivals that of renowned museums worldwide. It features works by esteemed artists like Caravaggio, Velázquez, Goya, and Sorolla, as if they were casually displayed in any home.
>
> The walls and ceilings, adorned with magnificent frescoes and embellished with gold accents, exude the dramatic Rococo style exemplified by artists such as Giaquinto. Each new room you enter will leave you in awe, experiencing luxury living at an unparalleled level.
>
> Venture to the upper levels for stunning views of Madrid's sun-kissed rooftops before returning to reality and your humble hotel room.
